root_cause: R84 R30 XYZRHW/screen and R33 fast-world/HUD right-eye restore failure branches armed future mono safety but did not explicitly veto publication of the current frame. Right draw failures already did so.

feature_contract.goal: Ensure right-eye render-target, depth, viewport and WVP state restoration failures invalidate the current R84 stereo frame across both XYZRHW/screen and fast-world/HUD physical submission, preventing incomplete DirectGPU and SkyGlow output.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R84 physical renderer previously marked the current frame on right-eye draw failure but not on right-eye restore failure across four actual GPU submission branches; a broken restoration leaves the immediately pending transport frame unsafe even though the next stereo epoch is guarded.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only physical right-eye state-restore failure branches in the R84 independent DX9Ex renderer; preserve successful draw path, original Draw HRESULT, left-eye behavior, SkyGlow math, R26_SAFE rollback, DX11, DXVK and game input.
trace_stages: Original game D3D9 raster submission runs through R84 independent R30 XYZRHW/screen or R33 fast-world/HUD owner.
After a successful left-eye draw R30/R33 submits the right-eye GPU draw and restores game RT/depth/viewport and optional shader c64.
Failure in this physical restore now marks FrameRightDrawFailed before invalidation and mono safety; the current frame snapshot refuses SkyGlow and DirectGPU stereo publication.
subcomponents: R30 patches both XYZRHW and screen/HUD branches to mark current-frame right-eye failure on any restore failure without affecting actual Draw HRESULT.
R33 patches both fast-world and HUD branches with the identical current-frame veto before depth invalidation and future recovery safety.
Bounded mutation verifier protects four independent branches, rejects marker deletion/condition inversion, and is wired to exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30 XYZRHW and HUD as well as R33 fast-world and HUD physical per-eye draw helpers call state restoration after left-eye and right-eye GPU submission, with exactly two if (!restoreOk) branches in each owner.
diagnosis.root_cause: R84 R30 XYZRHW/screen and R33 fast-world/HUD right-eye restore failure branches armed future mono safety but did not explicitly veto publication of the current frame. Right draw failures already did so.
source_trace: Original OutRun D3D9 primitive reaches R84 physical R30/R33 draw dispatcher under the latched stereo frame.
On right-eye RT/depth/viewport/c64 restoration failure each of four branches previously invalidated depth and armed mono recovery without explicitly setting current-frame FrameRightDrawFailed.
R29OwnerFrameSnapshot rightDrawFailed gates R30 stereo SkyGlow and current frame output; marking current failure before Present preserves valid stereo transport only.
alternatives_rejected: Do not mark a healthy frame failed or change the left-eye original HRESULT; marking only future recovery epoch does not veto the already-produced right-eye frame.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R30 and R33 now mark current-frame failure in each right-eye restore-failure branch. The original invalidation, failure reporting and future mono safety remain; the change does not widen semantic ownership or alter shader math.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: New active-gated verifier checks both R30 and both R33 restore paths, expected failure marker order, and six in-memory mutation counterexamples.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The left eye retains the normal original draw HRESULT, while any unsuccessful right-eye state restoration revokes binocular publication for that same frame before transport and SkyGlow.
